positiveThemes: Quick and efficient service delivery by fuel pump attendants
Good availability and range of engine oil and lubricant products
Confirmation of proper fuel amount and oil density
Accessibility and redemption value of XTRAREWARDS loyalty program
negativeThemes: Meter accuracy and suspected fuel dispensing manipulation
Allegations of fuel quality issues (adulteration, water mixing, excessive ethanol, kerosene admixture)
Long queue formation and substantial waiting times during peak hours
Limited operating hours (6 AM-10 PM) leading to complaints from customers seeking after-hours refueling
Mobile application reliability issues (crashes, loading failures, payment processing delays)
digitalPresence: The station relies on IndianOil's corporate digital presence (apps and web locators) for customer information access. It does not appear to operate proprietary social media accounts. Customer service is centralized through official IndianOil channels, with a direct contact number provided. Mobile app functionality, while theoretically available, suffers from reported technical deficiencies impacting user experience.

platformBreakdown.note: Overall satisfaction levels around 3.6-5.0 across the station network mentioned, with significant variance between individual locations.
A viral social media incident involving alleged fuel pump meter tampering at a different Delhi IOCL facility generated significant attention and customer anxiety regarding fuel dispensing honesty.
